title: Fixed telephone links in site navigation
summary: Architecture: Admin formats navigation destinations before saving them. Problem: web trailing-slash rules also modify telephone URIs, turning tel:+15555550100 into tel:+15555550100/. Solution: apply path trailing-slash rules only to HTTP and HTTPS URLs; preserve telephone URIs.
validation: Proposed formatter fix. Verify telephone numbers and extensions; HTTP child paths retain trailing slashes.
